pilot.comparison: Single existing mixture extended without parameter changes. 6k starting checkpoint is measured baseline; 12k/24k/48k/96k are diagnostic budgets, not presumed epochs or sufficient convergence. Two fixed seeds.
pilot.stopping: Authorized ceiling96k, no automatic extension beyond it. Report continuing improvement, plateau/instability, or training-fit/generalization separation from measured curves. Preserve improving validation weights and all milestones; never silently substitute a peak for the budget-ending result.

scope: Original shared Q MLP, directed_max, exact physical-step distance Huber plus complete-candidate soft-rank, unchanged weights and greedy32. Lossless packed feature lookup only avoids caching hundreds of millions of unused physical states. Original environment provides transitions.

continuation.purpose: Full continuation from the fixed 20% graph mixture at step6000. Only update budget changes; Adam, sampling RNG/order and exposure counters restored.

convergence.scope: Fixed 20% graph mixture, original shared Q/directed_max/Huber/full-candidate soft rank and greedy32. Inspect every accepted graph decision and all graph point labels at checkpoints; target and distance layer fit, true training teacher paths, alternative optimal/recoverable branch entry greedy, dense heldout global/adjacent order, fixed100-layout/200-goal validation, and original-training retention. No diagnostic feedback changes sampling. Preserve full milestone and improving validation weights. Mean exposure does not establish completed epochs or convergence.
